text:
maria_fin: FYI — Enterprise account 'Cobalt Health' received a 15% promotional credit that should have been limited to trial customers only. Promo code PROMO-Q2-15 was applied on invoice CH-7812 (2024-04-01). Net customer-facing credit = $9,750. We need to reverse and offer goodwill options.

owen_billing: Oof. Do we have the invoice lines?

maria_fin: Pasted redacted lines: 

```
Invoice CH-7812
2024-04-01
Line 4: usage-core (prod) 1,000,000 tokens = $65,000
Line 5: PROMO-Q2-15 (15%) = -$9,750
Total due: $55,250
```

hana_account_mgr: Customer contacted support asking why their discount appeared; they assumed it was deliberate and already adjusted their MQLs. We should be careful reversing without comms.

billing-bot: Heuristic: promo tag applied to non-eligible customer (enterprise). Flag: policy-exception. Suggested actions: either issue a manual goodwill credit of $9,750 with product note OR reverse promo and offer alternative (prorated discount on next invoice).

owen_billing: My recommended path: do NOT charge retroactively. Issue a goodwill credit of $9,750 now, but mark as one-time courtesy and update the promotion target to exclude enterprise accounts to prevent recurrence. Approve?

maria_fin: I approve issuing a one-time goodwill credit of $9,750 and adding a note to the customer's account: "Courtesy credit due to promo misrouting; not a new entitlement." Also update promo targeting filter.

hana_account_mgr: I will notify the customer with the following wording: "We issued a one-time credit of $9,750 after discovering an internal promo misconfiguration. This is a courtesy credit; we value our partnership and apologize for any confusion. No changes to your contract." Will share copy in the ticket.

owen_billing: Creating credit memo CM-CH-20240401-GW (amount: $9,750). Posting to ledger and marking reconciliation entry as 'promo misapply - courtesy'.

billing-bot: CM-CH-20240401-GW created (status: pending). Ticket FIN-2024-659 opened to track promo targeting fix and customer comms.

maria_fin: Adding action item for growth/product: restrict PROMO-Q2-15 to plans: [trial, startup] only. @product-ops please confirm.

hana_account_mgr: Sent comms draft to maria_fin for sign-off.

owen_billing: Posting credit now. Will attach adjusted ledger export to FIN-2024-659.

billing-bot: Actions: finance post credit, account manager send comms, product ops update promo targeting.

maria_fin: Thanks team — closing on our side once FIN ticket shows ledger attachment.
